# cursor_origin_repo (Data Source)

Reads an Origin repository from the public Origin API. Look up by owner and name, or by the repository's stable ID. The public API does not support updating or deleting repositories, so this is a data source rather than a managed resource. Uses the provider auth token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_origin_repo" "rocket" {
  owner = "acme"
  name  = "rocket"
}

# The public Origin API can also address a repository by its stable ID.
data "cursor_origin_repo" "by_id" {
  id = "repo_01k2ja2000e0080000000000q4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Stable Origin repository ID (for example repo_01...). Set this to look up the repository without owner and name. When looking up by owner and name, the ID is read from the API.
- `name` (String) Repository name within the owner. Required with owner unless id is set. Compared case-insensitively with the stored name.
- `owner` (String) Owner slug, the namespace the repository belongs to. Required with name unless id is set. Compared case-insensitively with the stored slug.

### Read-Only

- `allow_merge_commit` (Boolean) Whether pull requests may land as merge commits.
- `allow_squash_merge` (Boolean) Whether pull requests may land as squash merges.
- `clone_url` (String) HTTPS clone URL. Output-only; the path shape is not guaranteed.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 repository creation timestamp.
- `default_branch` (String) Repository default branch name.
- `delete_branch_on_merge` (Boolean) Whether the head branch is deleted automatically on merge.
- `full_name` (String) Combined owner and repository name, such as acme/rocket.
- `mirror` (Attributes) Mirror metadata. Null for a native repository and before a mirror's initial sync is ready. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mirror))
- `owner_id` (String) Stable Origin owner identifier.
- `owner_type` (String) Owner namespace type: team or user. Null when the API omits it.
- `pushed_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent push. Null until the first push.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 repository update timestamp.
- `visibility` (String) Repository visibility: internal or private.

<a id="nestedatt--mirror"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mirror`

Read-Only:

- `source` (String) Mirror source. Currently github.
- `source_id` (String) Opaque repository identifier assigned by the source.
- `status` (String) Effective mirror direction during a transition: inbound or outbound.
